info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API facilitates the retrieval of information regarding user parking reservation checkouts. This endpoint allows consumers, such as parking management systems and mobile applications, to obtain details related to current checkouts for reserved parking spots. Users can access critical data, including reservation status and related transaction information, enhancing the parking experience. Ideal for both developers integrating parking features and end users needing insights into their reservations, this API optimizes parking management processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout information for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the checkout details associated with their reservations, providing all necessary information to complete the payment process and finalize their booking.

requestBody.description: The request body for checking out reservations. It contains a JSON object that provides the details necessary to complete the checkout process.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the checkout information.
